title: Shopfi tenant onboarding API (PROV-03)
description: Request and response bodies of /api/v1/platform/onboarding/*. Every response body is the CustomApiResponse envelope {description, data}. Validated against the documented examples by OnboardingContractTest. Server-side rules that JSON Schema cannot express (reserved slugs beyond the listed ones, e-mail deliverability, byte length of the password) are documented in onboarding.md.

Slug.description: Tenant slug. The server trims and lowercases first; this schema describes the normalised form. 3-40 chars, lowercase letters and digits, single hyphens between them only.

Email.description: Shape check only (one @, no whitespace). The server uses Jakarta @Email and normalises case; deliverability is not checked.

password.description: Trimmed by the server. At least 8 characters; at most 72 UTF-8 bytes (BCrypt limit, so 72 is only exact for ASCII). Bean validation enforces 8..72 characters (field-map 400); over-72-byte multi-byte values are rejected by the service with 400.

plan.description: Deprecated (PLAN-03, owner O1): ignored by the server, any value of any type, never selects a plan and never causes a 400. Every new tenant gets the default sign-up plan. Clients should not send it. Interim until PLAN-01 merges: the server still rejects values other than FREE, STARTER, PRO with 400.

StoreLookupEnvelope.description: Find-store always answers 202 with this exact body, whatever the store state (API-RD-04).

description.const: If a store with that name exists, we've emailed its owner a link to sign in.

OnboardingStatus.description: data of signup, verify and status responses. storefrontUrl and adminLoginUrl are present only when status is ACTIVE and tenant.base-domain is configured; they are omitted (not null) otherwise. BILL-00 adds the optional keys phase, cardRequired, cardSetupToken, cardSetupExpiresAt and cardSetup (billing.md section 5), present only when the card step applies.

phase.description: BILL-00 (billing.md section 5), implemented by BILL-02: present only when the card step applies to this signup (absent otherwise, never null).

cardRequired.description: BILL-00: present only when the card step applies; true only while phase is AWAITING_CARD.

cardSetupToken.description: BILL-00: verify response only, while phase is AWAITING_CARD; never returned by GET /status. Single use, expires in at most 30 minutes.

cardSetup.description: BILL-00: what the card step displays (billing.md section 5.2). Same shape as CardSetup in billing.schema.json.

StatusEnvelope.description: Success envelope for signup (201), verify (202) and status (200).

ResendEnvelope.description: Resend always answers 202 with this exact body, whatever happened.

description.const: If a pending signup matches, a new verification code has been sent

ErrorEnvelope.description: Every non-2xx body. description is human readable and NOT a stable machine code; branch on the HTTP status. data is null, except for bean-validation failures (400) where it maps field name to message.
